## GROUND-TRUTH P1: merged change 2479 broke ALL main CI; fix 2501 in flight

Verified against CI (not agent-reported). Merging 2479 (this ticket's change) landed a composite `./.github/actions/setup-uv` that crashes on EVERY runner: PowerShell parses `$asset:` in the checksum-mismatch `throw "Checksum mismatch for $asset: ..."` (action.yml:70) as a scoped-variable reference, failing the action before uv installs.

Evidence — post-merge run 33574990286 on merged SHA 5ff99170: ALL jobs (ubuntu/macos/windows, py3.14/3.14t/3.15, lint+type, pip-audit, mutation) failed at step `Run ./.github/actions/setup-uv`. This is why the AC-1 anchor grep `Successfully installed uv 0.12.7` returned exit 1 on that run — a genuine (non-vacuous) failure, exactly the trap AC-1 was written to catch.

Fix: Gerrit 2501 "Fix setup-uv PowerShell checksum parsing" (rebar-ticket 5caa) — braces the interpolation (`${asset}:`) and extends the uv-pin guard to reject the same hazard. Mechanical correctness fix within the operator-approved Approach B; touches only action.yml + scripts/check_uv_pin.py + a guard test, NOT eb64's .github/workflows/*.yml, so no eb64 conflict. Its Verified gate golden-path (clean install) job PASSED = patchset installs uv, so no deadlock. Driving 2501 to land, then capturing post-merge AC evidence before closing 5caa.
